subject: Accountability proof pilot: SCIM/SAML/Role artifacts for SOC 2 & SIG
messages:
From: Michael Brooks <michael.brooks@medisync.com>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial intake: SOC 2 / SIG scope — access control artifacts

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking this on. MediSync is moving quickly on our annual SOC 2 and the vendor SIG review — I pulled together a short list of access-control artifacts our auditor and procurement team need to validate your controls. We're targeting a preliminary handoff to our external auditor the week of July 21.

High-level ask:
- SAML assertion samples (successful and expired) for the last 90 days
- SCIM delta export covering user creates/updates/deletes for May–June 2025 (CSV or JSON)
- Role entitlement matrix tying RBAC groups to resource scopes
- Inventory of service accounts and justification of least-privilege assignments

Attached is MediSync's questionnaire excerpt for the access/identity section (medisync-sig-questionnaire.pdf). Can you confirm what we can provide by next Friday (2025-07-11)? Also let us know if you need an encrypted upload location.

We can loop Pamela (compliance) on procurement/transfer specifics.

Appreciate it,
Michael Brooks
Senior Security Analyst — MediSync
security@medisync.com

Hi Michael — thanks for the clear list and the questionnaire. We're happy to support the handoff.

Quick plan proposal (high level):
1) Deliverables by EOD 2025-07-11 (preliminary) — scim delta sample, sample SAML assertions (redacted), and a condensed role-entitlement matrix.
2) Follow-up drop by 2025-07-18 — full service-account inventory + least-privilege justification notes and logs.
3) Secure transfer — we'll share a one-time Google Drive folder (encrypted at rest) and SFTP if you prefer; let us know the preference.

Irene — can you confirm availability to extract the SCIM delta and a small example of assertion logs? Vanessa — can you pull the latest role-entitlement CSV and a stub of the service-account inventory so we can redact PII before transfer?

We will avoid sharing full tokens or raw identities; assertion samples will be redacted (subject: user/email hashed) and include timestamps and SAML attributes as requested.

Sofia Ivanova

Redwood Inference

Hi all — I can pull the SCIM delta export and a short batch of SAML assertion samples. A few clarifying notes so we scope exactly what you need:

- SCIM delta: our system emits incremental deltas per tenant with event_type (create/update/delete), actor_id, target_id, timestamp, and changed_attributes. Do you need user profile snapshots or only the deltas? The full snapshot for two weeks can be provided if the auditor prefers.
- Time window: you asked for May–June 2025; can you confirm you need timezone-normalized timestamps (UTC preferred)?
- Redaction: we'll hash email addresses and remove IP addresses. If you require original IPs for SSO traceability we can provide a redacted mapping separately under NDA.

I will attach a small sample scim-delta-sample.csv to the handoff (redacted).

Irene Choi
Identity & Provisioning Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: scim-delta-sample.csv (redacted sample)
From: Michael Brooks <michael.brooks@medisync.com>

Date: Thu, 10 Jul 2025 11:45:00 -07:00

Thanks, Irene — that all sounds good. A couple follow-ups from the auditor:

- For the role entitlement matrix, we need mapping to least-privilege rationale (one-line reason per role). A CSV with column headings: role_id, role_name, permissions_summary, justification, owner.
- Service accounts: just send inventory (name, owner, last-used, scope) and an explanation for any account with wildcard or broad perms.
- Evidence delivery: Google Drive is fine if you enable a time-limited link and restrict to the three addresses in this thread. If possible, SFTP would be preferred for the full inventory.

I'll open a HubSpot record (HubSpot: 006745-MediSync-SECQ) and we can post links there. Pamela — please confirm transfer preference.

Regards,
Michael

- 2025-07-18 (drop): full role-entitlement matrix CSV + service-account-inventory-stub.xlsx (redacted), with one-line least-privilege justification per role/account.
